final: WITH media AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS average_ratio FROM media) SELECT media.media_type_name, media.ratio, media.track_count, media.ratio - overall.average_ratio FROM media CROSS JOIN overall WHERE overall.average_ratio IS NOT NULL AND media.ratio > overall.average_ratio
